summary: Iteration 24 — Backend-only regression run for the 3 HIGH-severity fixes (AI apply endpoint URL contract, veg classifier meat-beats-vegetables safety, reclassify-veg overwrite=False default) plus source review of the employee/Menu.js multi-vendor checkout loop. Ran 124 tests across 7 files: test_veg_classifier (44), test_apply_endpoint (9, 1 skipped due to corporate-only registration), test_free_menu_photos (9), test_allergen_classifier (20), test_onboarding_menu (15), test_storage_upload (11), test_session_persistence (16). ALL 124 passing; 0 failures. Paid gpt-image-1 tests (test_ai_photos_and_agreement live gen / test_ai_photo_spend) intentionally skipped per instruction to preserve Emergent LLM budget. Menu.js source review confirms placeOrdersForAllVendors iterates allVendorIds sequentially, does create-order → openRazorpayCheckout → verify per vendor, tracks paidVendors[] and failures[], only deletes successfully paid vendor carts from cartByVendor (line 333-340) — no orderIds[0]-only path, no unconditional setCartByVendor({}) clear. Cancel-intent short-circuit via break on 'Payment cancelled'.
critical_code_review_comments: veg_classifier.py: safety-first rule order is correct — EXPLICIT_NON_VEG_RE and DEFINITE_NON_VEG_RE short-circuit before STRONG_VEG_RE is even consulted, so 'Palak Chicken', 'Chicken Corn Soup', 'Chicken Dal' all return non-veg as required. STRONG_VEG_TOKENS list is tight and excludes ambiguous produce (corn/peas/palak/mushroom) which was the actual iter24 bug.

reclassify_batch(only_missing=True) correctly preserves manual overrides — a chicken row erroneously tagged veg by a vendor stays veg (respecting manual intent) while a row with no is_vegetarian set gets auto-filled. This is the dietary-safety default the review asked for.

server.py menu_items_reclassify_veg now accepts ?overwrite=bool=False and returns {changed,total,scope,overwrite} — response shape verified in TestReclassifyLiveMenuItems.test_scope_by_vendor. Audit-log side effect preserved.

ai_menu_photos.py apply endpoint: photo_url is preferred, legacy ai_<hex>.png returns 400 with 'regenerate' guidance (test_apply_rejects_legacy_ai_filename_400 green), path traversal '../etc/passwd' + backslashes + subdirs all 400 (test_apply_rejects_path_traversal green), missing both fields 400 (test_apply_requires_url_or_filename green), bogus schemes (file://, javascript:, ftp://, '') 400/422 (test_apply_rejects_bogus_url_scheme green).

employee/Menu.js placeOrdersForAllVendors (lines 268-345): correct per-vendor sequential loop; failures array captures {vId,label,message}; paidVendors[] drives selective cart-clear at line 333-340; 'Payment cancelled' triggers break so the user isn't force-marched through remaining vendor modals. No regression risk in the reviewed source.

MINOR (non-blocking): test_apply_nonadmin_forbidden is SKIPPED because /api/auth/register is corporate-email-only in preview — the 403 path is still exercised in other suites via employee-role tokens. Consider adding an admin-created scratch employee helper fixture for full coverage.

success_rate.backend: 100% (124/124 executed; 1 skip is env-limited, not a failure)
success_rate.frontend: N/A — testing_type=backend only; Menu.js verified via source review only per instruction

seed_data_creation: TEST_vendor_*, TEST_vrej_*, TEST_apply_* scratch rows auto-cleaned by fixtures; no lingering rows.
